pull_request.title: Calorimeter: compact LAr prototype with hadron-depth and matched electron controls
pull_request.head: codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype
pull_request.body:
The strict-radius-ratio compact LAr prototype fits the retained tracker/solenoid reservation and passes the sampled material-depth screen, but **does not preserve core precision**. Warm bore1700mm; sampling1772.8–2103.65mm; warm outer2395.35mm. ALLEGRO inclination and relative barrel radii are retained. Cold boards are repacked within210mm rear bath; vessel/vacuum/service budgets remain explicit. Endcaps deepen to650mm with original wheel radii/materials/inclination.

Native component/combined audits report zero overlaps. A finite9088-ray scan including actual electrode phases has minimum25.613359 sampling X0, separate from vessel/services. The earlier600mm support-band shortfall is retained. These geometric controls do not certify pressure/thermal design or multi-TeV containment.

All10000 matched10–80GeV electrons completed with12workers and full saved-event readback:6754284 positive canonical hits. Exact serial/MT24 controls (15584hits),100-event step-policy pilots and frozen primary/compact/material checks pass. Wall811.96s, peak3.383GiB, ROOT20.213GB; no disk trimming.

| Fixed population | Raw width: original → compact | Exploratory held-out calibrated width: original → compact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Inclusive |17.84→52.57% |13.12→6.00% |
| Core barrel, abs(eta)<1.2 |3.52→6.56% |2.43→4.30% |
| Transition,1.2–1.5 |44.18→4.09% |40.62→3.92% |
| Endcap region,1.5–3 |7.66→10.42% |3.09→7.36% |

Raw R=S/Etrue remains primary; mixed-spectrum SD/mean is not intrinsic reconstructed resolution. Candidate broad-region gain differences explain95.34% of inclusive raw variance. The secondary eta-only gain family was chosen after raw inspection: five held-out folds and1000shared refit bootstraps prevent direct gain-fit leakage but do not create independent validation. Ideal truth direction, absolute energy closure and energy-by-region controls remain explicit. Core paired calibrated change is+1.87pp [1.72,2.04], endcap+4.27pp [3.39,5.14], pointwise95%. Improved transition cannot hide these losses.

![Native envelope](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/09c48b3f1c09b1969754ac9c39debd40e5c6d31e/docs/validation/lar-compact/figures/compact-envelopes.png?raw=true)
![Matched raw controls](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/4e641c0df1e1302e5ab4a52039f4a887753951fd/docs/validation/lar-compact/figures/angular-comparison.png?raw=true)
![Exploratory held-out controls](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5e8b13aa1a8b8ae7941a78e75e5e7da2dcf414b1/docs/validation/lar-compact/figures/calibrated-angular-widths.png?raw=true)

[Design/tradeoffs](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/design/inputs/DES-032-compact-hadron-prototype.md) · [All distributions, closure, SVG/PDF/PNG and reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-compact/README.md) · [Calibration fold models and separate full-fit reuse table](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-compact/calibration-models.json)

Reusable forward-gain API accepts signal/direction with compact/material identity checks and no true-energy application input. The full-fit reuse table needs fresh validation.38analysis tests and2compact budget tests pass; independent PhysVal reviews and exact closed specialist accounting accompany the results.

A conditional thicker barrel option is screened read-only, not implemented:1248 periods, restored1.8mmPb/~1.207mm inner LAr gap,Rout2350mm,warmouter2641.7mm. It retains normalized radial compartment fractions but changes global Rout/Rin; user clarification is pending. Approximate-material chord screens are not native validation or precision evidence. Broad-endcap precision needs separate investigation.

TASK-LAR-COMPACT-HADRON;DES026/032/033. **DRAFT / opt-in PROTOTYPE**, with maintained LAYOUT-002 and human approval states unchanged. Raw ROOT/events/XML/logs stay local; only source, compact binwise evidence and scientific figures are published. Pressure/thermal/routing, digitization, pileup/radiation, high-energy leakage and detector acceptance remain open. Unique closed-turn accounting and PR interactions feed the existing project/token Pages workflow; active parent usage remains unknown.


Follow-up diagnosis: the barrel tradeoff is thicker Pb (1.8→2.6mm) and a much smaller initial LAr gap (~1.196→0.484mm), consistent with reduced sampling quality. Central native active chords roughly halve; fixed45–50GeV held-out barrel widths remain1.97→3.92%. This is a supported mechanism inference, not a one-parameter causal ablation or a tested mitigation.

The broad-endcap penalty is concentrated in1.5≤abs(eta)<1.8 (held-out2.00→15.30%); the1.8–3bulk point widths are3.31→2.87%. This post-hoc descriptive split does not change the primary broad-region result or establish noninferiority. [Underlying distributions, sampling evidence and mitigation options](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-compact/diagnosis.md), with exact aggregate histograms and PNG/PDF/SVG, are now retained. No new transport or calibration fit.

![Raw regional response distributions](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/0613fe1459e84bb89c7f459232ed97d4842b86c6/docs/validation/lar-compact/figures/regional-raw-distributions.png?raw=true)

The diagnosis received a separate exact-revision PhysVal assessment with no material findings after clarifying that0.7mm production-cut convergence for the new small gaps is untested. Production thresholds are not tracking cuts, so this is not a claim that Geant4 cannot resolve the gaps.40analysis unit tests pass, including saved-fold exclusion and histogram-flow guards.

**LAR-COMPACT-PHYSVAL-PROTOCOL** reviewed at **f3ece1d6a6816c8172dfa841d63e5424730e8228**. These are prospective characterization criteria, without a numerical noninferiority threshold.

Preserve services, material and readout representations except explicitly documented candidate changes. Verify complete native readback and configuration hashes. **LAR-COMPACT-CALOTECH-DESIGN** — examined **f3ece1d6a6816c8172dfa841d63e5424730e8228**. Read-only contribution; **no files changed, native runtime or transport run**.

The proposed **1408-plane barrel and 600 mm-deep endcaps are geometrically feasible** in the existing standard-library generators. Both have margin above a provisional **25 X₀ sampling-depth target** in the analytic screens below. Native material scans and the matched electron test remain necessary.

### Proposed barrel

Preserve inclination **50.18°**, `Rout/Rin = 1.186625552282769`, and every normalized sampling-compartment boundary.

| Parameter | Proposed value |
|---|---:|
| Warm bore | 1700 mm |
| Front wall/vacuum/cold-wall/bath | 10 / 49 / 3.8 / 10 mm |
| Sampling inner radius | 1772.8 mm |
| Sampling outer radius | 2103.649779 mm |
| Electrode path through annulus | 468.278618 mm |
| Planes | 1408 |
| Pb / total steel / glue / PCB | 2.6 / 0.2 / 0.1 / 1.2 mm |
| Initial single LAr gap | approximately 0.484 mm |

Scaled electrode-compartment lengths are:

`19.059232, 38.811412, 39.966572, 41.121649, 42.507792, 43.778402, 45.279995, 46.781669, 48.514327, 50.246984, 52.210543 mm`.

**Actual checks:** generator construction passed; annular partition residual **−1.01×10⁻¹³**. At the retained 3910 mm sampling half-length it gives **2,264,064 logical barrel channels**. Exact polygon intersections over 16 uniformly spaced electrode phases give estimated sampling depth **25.620–26.152 X₀**.

Those X₀ estimates use explicitly approximate material lengths: Pb 5.612, LAr 140, steel 17.5, glue 180 and PCB 180 mm. Replace them with native material values before claiming the depth gate passed.

The first 1.8 mm-Pb compact control retained only approximately 20.3 X₀ sampling. Increasing lead is therefore material-depth driven, before inspecting shower results.

### Endcap depth amendment

The historical native package values around **24.7–25.1 X₀** include vessel walls, services and bath. Independent piece intersections give only about **21 X₀ sampling** over much of the interior. Moving that package axially alone would leave the depth requirement unmet.

The parent's proposed **600 mm sampling depth**, preserving Pb 1.1 mm, PCB 1.3 mm, 49° inclination, wheel radii and period counts, passed construction with:

- Warm front/back **5100 / 6210 mm**.
- Sampling front/back **5210 / 5810 mm**.
- Cold front/back **5200 / 6060 mm**, retaining the 250 mm rear bath.
- Minimum sampled LAr gaps **0.781095 / 1.115684 / 1.191363 mm** across the three wheels.
- Partition residuals no larger than **5.60×10⁻¹¹**.
- Unchanged **1,203,200 logical channels** and **9856 sensitive volumes**.

Analytic sampling-depth estimates at `|eta| = 1.5, 1.8, 2.3, 2.8, 3.0` are respectively **29.72, 28.66, 27.97, 28.04, 29.65 X₀**. The intersection calculation reproduces historical native Pb chords to approximately **3×10⁻¹¹ mm** in the unchanged control.

The deeper blade increases the inner-wheel Cartesian-versus-cylindrical taper discrepancy from **0.11685 to 0.19869 mm**. Preserve that approximation explicitly and verify native geometry, phase dependence and the transition.

### Evidence and interpretation

The [CMS calibration paper, §2/PDF4–5](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1306.2016) gives crystal lengths and radiation length corresponding to approximately **25.8/24.7 X₀** in barrel/endcap. This supports **25 X₀ as an unsigned nODD screening choice**, rather than proving sufficiency for every 14 TeV pp shower.

The [ALLEGRO EOI, §2/PDF3–4]([external URL redacted; see source journal]) supports the 1.2 mm multilayer barrel electrode. I found no directly applicable thin-ALLEGRO-electrode construction precedent in the inspected sources. Retaining it avoids introducing an additional readout redesign.

The existing **SRC-FCC-HH-CALO-2019** PDF was read locally and its SHA-256 matched the manifest. **§2.2.2/PDF25** describes 0.5 mm LAr drift gaps and 1.2 mm seven-layer electrodes. That establishes a studied gap scale near this proposal, while its FCC-hh rate assumptions remain distinct. PDF text extraction emitted fontTools warnings; no layout verification or installation was performed.

**Precision is an unresolved test outcome.** The barrel proposal increases Pb thickness by 44.4%, reduces plane count by 8.33%, and substantially reduces active LAr path. Compare barrel and endcap energy-bin widths separately, alongside inclusive/angular means and tails: improved transition response could conceal worse barrel sampling precision. The old calibration model requires a new geometry binding and validation; the 10–80 GeV sample cannot establish TeV containment, pileup tolerance or digitized precision.

**Radial service implications:** with existing three-bank offsets, board-bank fronts become **2365/2410/2455 mm**, N₂ pipe centre **2547 mm**, and bath back **2560 mm**. The existing 1000 mm front reservation exceeds the inherited two-arc bound of **854.08 mm** for the 100 mm jacket with 400 mm bends. HCAL front 3130 mm leaves **488.3 mm** beyond the barrel warm wall. Ports, supports and actual routing still require native/interface checks.

The canonical φ cell span changes to `2π/624 ≈ 0.01007 rad`; its inner physical pitch remains approximately **17.85 mm**, close to the original **17.78 mm**. Outer gaps and angular granularity change, so depth calibration and a new matched 10k comparison remain necessary. **No precision-preservation claim follows from this screen.**
